text:
A converging lens is being used as a magnifying glass.
Which statement is correct?
A
The image is further away from the lens than the object is.
B
The image is inverted.
C
The image is real.
D
The object must be placed at the principal focus of the lens.

options.label: A
options.text: The image is further away from the lens than the object is.

options.label: D
options.text: The object must be placed at the principal focus of the lens.
